summaries.summary: The image illustrates the four stroke engine cycle, including the exhaust stroke, and labels key components such as the exhaust valve, piston, and burned gases. It also shows the exhaust stroke as the final phase where burned gases are expelled from the cylinder.
key_facts: The exhaust stroke is the fourth phase of the four-stroke engine cycle.
The exhaust valve opens to expel burned gases.
The piston moves upward during the exhaust stroke.
Burned gases are expelled through the exhaust valve.
